g.text: Five dyads, 185 bp apart. Each dyad contributes 1 at one genomic base; all other values are 0.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Calibri', 'Carlito', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #5b6671

g.text: This 925 bp unmasked region has 925 − d possible position pairs. Zero-signal bases still count.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Calibri', 'Carlito', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #5b6671

g.text: In this constructed example, all four normalized peaks equal 1/185 ≈ 0.00541.
